_readme: LoRA registry for PromptForge. Each entry: id, name, file (as ComfyUI lists it in models/loras), base ('illustrious'|'pony'|'noobai'|'sdxl'|'krea2'|'anima'), triggers (words that must be in the prompt), default_weight, clip_skip (null when none), source_url, notes. `checkpoints` maps a checkpoint file name to its base so a LoRA of another base gives a warning; an unlisted checkpoint gives no base warning. The model importer fills this file. An entry may list `aliases`: the display names other sites (Tungsten, Civitai) give the same file, used when reading an image's recipe.

loras.notes: Style LoRA; recipe weight 0.55 from the Gobs reference.

loras.name: Huffslove (Anima)
loras.notes: Trained on anima-preview. Needs the Anima checkpoint, text encoder and VAE; not usable on Illustrious. Its base model is non-commercial.
